k53.e: The purpose is not to manufacture a token or prove an economic theory in sixty minutes.
k53.t: sza3-bi ku3 dim2-ma in-nu • danna-bar disz-a nig2-szid ku3-ka nu-mu-un-gub
k53.g: its heart is not the fashioning of silver • in one hour no reckoning of silver is established

k53.e: It is to test whether thought, time, contribution, disagreement, decision, and learning can become more visible when people coordinate deliberately.
k53.t: gesztu2 u4 kin inim nu-sa2-a ka-asz u3 zu-zu • un gu2 disz-sze3 gar-ra-ta igi-a he2-gal2 • ur5 he2-zu
k53.g: thought, time, work, the unequal word, decision, and learning — when the people set their necks together, may these stand in view • may this be tested

k53.e: A civilization-scale framework should prove that its smallest meaningful act can still preserve its largest principles.
k53.t: gesz-hur kalam-ma-ka kin tur-bi-e inim gal-bi szu-a he2-tuku
k53.g: in the land's plan may its smallest work hold its greatest word in hand

k54.g: afterward may the hour's tablet be returned (replayed)

k54.e: Could someone who was not present understand what you attempted?
k54.g: does the person who did not stand there know your work

k54.e: Did the record distinguish Human judgment from AI assistance?
k54.t: dub-e di lu2-ka u3 a2 gesztu2 dim2-ma-ka mu-un-bar
k54.g: did the tablet set apart the human's judgment and the fashioned understanding's arm
was the true time written faithfully

k54.e: Did someone contribute an insight that might otherwise have disappeared?
k54.g: did one person give the word that else would have slipped away
did the unequal word remain in view

k54.e: Did the group discover an assumption?
k54.g: did the group find the uncounted (unexamined) word

k54.e: Could another group understand why something changed?
k54.t: un disz-e nig2 bal-a sza3-bi mu-un-zu
k54.g: does another group know the heart (reason) of what changed

k54.e: Would the next group begin better informed because this group left evidence behind?
k54.t: un egir-ra nig2-gi-na gub-ba-zu-ta zu-a mu-un-gub
k54.g: does the next group stand up knowing, from the proof you set down
if not, may the road be turned toward the good
if it is so, may it be done again
one hour turns into the next cycle
the cycles turn into firm learning
firm learning walks into the tablet-house
the tablet-house turns the next generation toward the good

k54.e: The architecture grows only as evidence earns expansion.
k54.g: only through proof does the house walk toward greatness

k54.e: Scale begins not with size, but with a small process worth repeating.
k54.t: nam-gal nig2 gal-ta nu-mu-un-gub • kaskal tur gi4-gi4-da-ta mu-un-gub
k54.g: greatness does not stand up from the big thing • it stands up from a small road worth returning to

k55.e: This is where Master of Thought returns to Humanity.
k55.t: ki-bi-a en sag ki nam-lu2-ulu3-sze3 mu-un-gi4
k55.g: in this place EN SAG.KI returns to humankind

k55.e: It was never meant to remain the name of one author.
k55.g: it is not the standing name of one scribe

k55.e: It names a responsibility any person can accept, while Thought Mastery names the discipline through which that responsibility is practiced.
k55.t: en sag ki mu nam-kin-ka-am3 • lu2 na-me szu-a he2-tuku • nam-gesztu2 mu kaskal-bi-ka-am3
k55.g: EN SAG.KI is the name of the responsibility — any person may take it in hand • thought-mastery is the name of its road (discipline)

k55.e: A person who lives that discipline becomes a Thought Master: aware of thought before turning it into consequence; honest about time and contribution; willing to listen beyond the self; able to use technology without surrendering authority; committed to preserving what happened; willing to learn from reality; and determined to leave the next person a better beginning.
k55.t: lu2 kaskal-bi du-a lu2 gesztu2-ga-sze3 mu-un-bal • gesztu2-bi igi egir-bi-ka mu-un-zu • u4 u3 kin-bi gi-na • gesztu2-sze3 gub-ba • gesz dim2-ma szu-a tuku-a nam-en nu-sum-ma • nig2 gal2-la sar-ra • ki zi-ta zu-a • lu2 egir-ra-ra sag sig5 mu-un-gub
k55.g: the person who walks that road turns into a thought master • he knows his thought before its aftermath • his time and his work are honest • he stands toward the ear • he holds the machine in hand without giving over the lordship • what happened is written • he learns from the true ground • for the person after he sets a better beginning

k55.e: That is the responsibility of a Master of Thought.
k55.g: this is the responsibility of EN SAG.KI

k55.e: That is Measurement of Time transformed into meaning.
k55.t: ur5 nig2-szid u4-ka sza3 inim-ma-sze3 bal-a-am3
k55.g: this is the reckoning of time turned into the word's heart (meaning)

k55.e: That is Innovation at the Speed of Thought disciplined by evidence.
k55.t: ur5 kin dim2-ma gesztu2-gin7 du-a nig2-gi-na-e dab5-ba-am3
k55.g: this is the making-work that moves like thought, held fast by proof

k55.e: That is Vision • 2525 reduced to its Human beginning: one person, one thought, one measured hour, one honest record, and a future that does not have to start over.
k55.t: ur5 ⟦Vision • 2525⟧ sag lu2-ka-sze3 gi4-a-am3 • lu2 disz gesztu2 disz danna-bar disz sar-ra dub disz gi-na • u4 egir-ra ki sag-ta nu-mu-un-gi4
k55.g: this is Vision • 2525 returned to its human beginning: one person, one thought, one recorded hour, one honest tablet • the days after do not go back to the starting place
